policy: No cumulative catalog, schema, generated SQL, or live database was edited. The manual class defaults are materialized as HeroSkill foreign-key rows for Recruitable heroes only. No class JSON profile is invented.

printed pp.40-43 / PDF pages 41-44, Hero Screen and class context
supports: The Types table says heroes start with class-specific attributes and skills: Barbarian Advanced Pathfinding; Knight Basic Ballistics and Basic Leadership; Necromancer Basic Wisdom and Basic Necromancy; Sorceress Basic Wisdom and Advanced Navigation; Warlock Basic Wisdom and Advanced Scouting; Wizard Advanced Wisdom.
The current catalog contains 54 HeroHOMM2 rows with Availability Recruitable, exactly nine in each of the six classes; 19 CampaignOnly and four MapOnly rows are excluded.
HeroSkill stores the game, hero, skill, and non-null Mastery foreign-key path; the existing H3 rows establish the project-wide junction representation.
